recommendation.rule: for each unread policy, highest tested recency weight with Recall@5 and nDCG@5 at least equal to the cosine-only baseline; selected policy matches current creation-age behavior

limitations: Small controlled corpus; use results as a calibration signal, not as a quality claim for a user's private store.
The positive labels identify one expected document per query; negative queries have no relevant document.
Temporal and importance profiles are synthetic and fixed for reproducibility.
No production defaults are changed automatically; review the scorecard before adopting its recommendation.
